description: This file contains utility functions and state management logic for synchronizing application state, including merging states, getting and setting local state, and handling store data related to chat sessions, prompts, masks, and configuration.

methods.name: getNonFunctionFileds
methods.description: Returns an object containing only non-function properties of the input object.

methods.name: GetStoreState
methods.description: Type utility to extract non-function state from store objects.

methods.name: getLocalAppState
methods.description: Retrieves the current local application state from all stores.

methods.name: setLocalAppState
methods.description: Sets the application state in all stores based on provided state object.

methods.name: mergeAppState
methods.description: Merges remote application state into local state for all store segments.

methods.name: mergeWithUpdate
methods.description: Merges two states based on their lastUpdateTime, with older state being overridden.
